title: Water
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names ways of storing water and says why it must be kept clean and covered.
representations: a jerrycan, a clay pot, a bucket with a lid
an open and a covered cup left for a day
a picture of a roof tank
steps: Say why water must be kept safe.
Practise storing water in a covered bottle.
contexts: a home with a roof tank

board.do: Draw an open bucket with flies and a covered jerrycan.

board.say: Is this water safe to drink?

board.do: Wait for the child to say no and why.

misconceptions.ask: Which keeps drinking water safe: an open bucket or a covered jerrycan?
misconceptions.repair: Leave an open and a covered cup for a day. Look at dust and insects.

misconceptions.ask: Should a water jerrycan be washed?
misconceptions.repair: Shine a torch into an old jerrycan. Show the green slime. Wash it.

misconceptions.ask: Do animals need safe water too?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about cows getting sick from dirty water. Show a clean trough.

misconceptions.ask: What can happen if you drink dirty water?
misconceptions.repair: Tell a short story of a family who got sick from uncovered water. Link cause and effect.

checks.question: Name a way to store water.
Why do we cover stored water?
checks.answer: To keep out dust, insects and germs
